name: White Columns
notes:
Address and hours confirmed directly on the site. Founded 1970 (Jeffrey Lew, Gordon Matta-Clark et al.), oldest artist-run nonprofit still operating in NYC. Nominatim geocodes this address to 'Meatpacking District' but the gallery and most press describe it as West Village; tagged west-village accordingly. Current programming at add time: 'White Columns Online #37: unhomely' (Jul 17–Sep 12, 2026), with a group show (Mieko Meguro, Eric Spencer, Juliette Collet) save-the-dated for Sep 12–Oct 24.
